data.description: Fully Upgraded | Corner Unit | Lake View
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this beautifully maintained Type 3E villa located in the highly sought-after community of Springs 14, The Springs. Positioned on a desirable corner plot, this home offers enhanced privacy, generous outdoor space, and a tranquil family-friendly environment, making it ideal for end users seeking comfort and convenience.

The villa features a spacious and functional layout with three well-sized bedrooms plus a maid’s room, thoughtfully designed to accommodate family living. The home benefits from brand-new air conditioning units throughout, ensuring optimal comfort all year round. The kitchen is exceptionally well maintained and remains in excellent condition, offering ample cabinetry and workspace for everyday use.

The bright open-plan living and dining areas are filled with natural light, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Large windows open out to a private landscaped garden, complete with mature greenery—perfect for outdoor dining, relaxation, or children’s play.
Residents enjoy the advantage of being within walking distance to community parks, swimming pools, and scenic lakes, promoting an active and peaceful lifestyle.

The property also includes two covered parking spaces and is situated in a quiet residential location within the community.
Vacant and ready for immediate move-in, this villa presents an excellent opportunity to enjoy one of Dubai’s most 
established and well-connected townhouse communities.

Key Features:

Type 3E layout (corner unit)
3 bedrooms + maid’s room
Brand-new AC units
Well-maintained kitchen
Open-plan living and dining areas
Private landscaped garden
Walking distance to parks, pools, and lakes
2 covered parking spaces
Vacant and move-in ready

Contact Provident Real Estate today to arrange a viewing.
